payload.title: Standing instructions for entrusted long complex unattended work in Herdr
payload.choice: Prepare and maintain a native Goal, native plan, and source-owned continuity without requiring the user to repeat those requests for qualifying entrusted work.

authority.scope: This user's entrusted long, complex, unattended Codex work in Herdr; future concrete work retains its own effect authority and boundaries.

conditions: The user actually entrusts sustained complex work intended to continue unattended; ordinary tasks do not qualify.
Read native Goal state first and reuse the current active Goal without creating a competitor or silently changing its scope.
Create a Goal only if no unfinished Goal exists; objective at most 4000 characters and token_budget only when explicitly provided.
Use native plans and bounded English typed source-owned continuity records at material boundaries.
After compaction or handoff, rehydrate from current records and verify live identities before action.
Use on-demand workers and state waits; native internal delegation remains allowed.
Herdr controls require HERDR_ENV=1 and the existing herdr skill.
preservedBoundaries: Explicit stop, pause, manual-resume, evaluation budget, selected profile, permissions and excluded domains.
Completed, consumed and uncertain effects are not replayable; correlated receipts retain their original identity.
No new model evaluation suite, second agent runtime, scheduler, hook configuration or session replica.
No resumed provider-drift repair, paused Work mutation, direct pane-to-pane messaging test, automatic merge or remote deployment through this record.
No claim that compaction is prevented or multi-day process survival is guaranteed.

sourceEvidence.description: The parent explicitly relayed the actual 2026-10-15 user request and native create_goal authorization in this bounded implementation task. This record is a paraphrase, not a fabricated direct quote or a deployment receipt.
